invariants.rationale: The method interacts with the TiledMap instance, so it must not be null.
MapLayers is used to add loaded layers, so must be non-null.
Element is dereferenced via getName(), so it must not be null at entry.
FileHandle is passed to other loader methods, so expected to be non-null.
ImageResolver may be used in some branches, so it is required to be non-null.
